'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Barry Alperstein DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Username '''MrFromMars'''. Shorthand expanded from scan.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation|Imperial Occupation (V)]]
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
